summary: Csquare, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the underwriters' exercise of the overallotment option in its recently completed IPO. The underwriters purchased 7,499,000 additional shares at the IPO price of $21.00 per share, generating additional net proceeds of approximately $149.6 million, bringing total IPO net proceeds to about $1,159.6 million. This is a routine post-IPO greenshoe exercise, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring. The filing is informational only and does not involve a change in control, strategy, or capital structure beyond the expected IPO mechanics. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
